newsitem.title: USA: KN buys Enron's Bushton natgas facility.
newsitem.headline: KN buys Enron's Bushton natgas facility.

text.p: KN Energy Inc said in a statement it is to buy Enron Corp's Bushton natural gas processing facility and other Hugoton Basin gathering assets for an undisclosed sum.

The complex processes approximately 825 million cubic feet per day of natural gas and produces about 1.2 million gallons per day of liquids, 1.5 million cubic feet per day of pure helium and approximately 2 million cubic feet of raw helium.
The Hugoton Basin assets gather 475 million cubic feet per day of natural gas through some 2,200 miles of pipeline extending through Kansas and Oklahoma.
KN Energy will take over operations on or by March 31, the company said.
It added that the purchases fits well with its plans to build its presence in the midwest and complements the company's Pony Express pipeline.
